code='''def transform(grid):
    holes = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 0]
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in holes)
    r1 = max(r for r, _ in holes)
    c0 = min(c for _, c in holes)
    c1 = max(c for _, c in holes)
    return [[grid[len(grid) - 1 - r][c] if grid[r][c] == 0 else grid[r][c]
             for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
'''
path=base/'task-e0651234.py'
path.write_text(code)
print(path)
